0022600203.text: The Hawks (7-4, first in the Southeast and fourth in the East) host the Lakers (8-2, first in the West and Pacific), with Atlanta on a four-game winning streak and 6-4 over its last ten. Five Hawks are out: Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Lakers winning 141-116 in Los Angeles on January 13, 2026, the last time they played.
